description: This file defines the implementation of the em_mgr_t class, responsible for managing Ethernet management nodes, processing network events, handling threading, and interfacing with external modules such as OpenSSL and platform-specific network interfaces. It includes functions for packet processing, node creation/deletion, event dispatching, and network listening loops.
